concepts.name: Rally Relic
concepts.direction: A dynamic diagonally leaning trophy emblem made from fused objects: a game controller forms the wide top of a sculptural cup; a partial basketball texture becomes one side of its bowl; a simple sweeping film strip curls down into the trophy stem and a donut-shaped ring acts as the base. Make all four cues recognizable but use minimal lines. Two angular tournament bracket arms sit behind the silhouette, slightly tilted in the same direction. Bold thick sweeping shapes and just one diagonal sense of motion; no external speed lines, no explosions yet. Energetic, compact and sports-brand-like while clearly welcoming games, movies and food too.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: early logo concept mockup for the brand It's a Competition, an energetic bracket-making website for ANY kind of rivalry. This is a design direction to review before a final render, not a finished illustration. Make ONE strong integrated logo mark. Must visibly combine four recognizable simple symbols: a game controller, a sports ball (basketball), a movie clapperboard or film strip, and a food symbol. A two-sided tournament bracket sits clearly behind the mark. The overall assembled silhouette should suggest a trophy or award. Use bold clean vector-like flat matte shapes, thoughtful negative space, minimal internal details, confident medium-weight linework; polished design-studio concept, playful and grown-up. Palette limited to deep space navy #101E3A, electric sky blue #65B8FF, energy yellow #F4D04E, chalk #F5F7FA. Uniform solid deep navy background. Square canvas, centered mark taking about 65% of the canvas with generous breathing room, straight-on. Do not include any letters, words, numbers, title labels, watermark, mockup stationery, app screens, extra decorative stars, rays, gradients, metallic lighting or 3D rendering. Every symbol should belong to a single brand mark rather than four separate stickers around a trophy. The bracket must look like tournament branching paths, not an electronic circuit. Keep the silhouette readable at navigation-logo scale.
